title: spells
summary: Benilla's cast pipeline covers the four CMSG_CAST_SPELL target shapes, cancels, cast results, SPELL_START/GO, failures, delays, channel updates, aura duration, visuals, and chain targets. MSUI now implements that concrete family: GameObject OPEN_LOCK casts byte-match target mask 0x0800, and both SPELL_GO hit lists and SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS feed the one-consumer caster hop list used by cast and channel chain visuals.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS has no handler - the channeled-beam hop list (Drain Life / Mind Flay style, vmangos sends it from SendChannelStart) is dropped, so packet-delivered chain visuals have no data source
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: the strict chain-target packet is routed into the same caster-owned hop list as SPELL_GO hits; the next type-0/type-12 chain CharProc consumes it once, with channel-object fallback, one-shot expiry, persistent teardown, and clinical coverage against actual build-5875 Chain Lightning/Drain Life rows.

openItems.text: GameObject cast mask divergence: WorldSession.BuildCastSpellOnGameObjectBody writes target mask 0x4800 (GAMEOBJECT|0x4000 LOCKED) where Benilla decision 0939 byte-verified the real client sends 0x0800 alone - the LOCKED bit is a client-internal targeting-word bit that never rides the wire
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: BuildCastSpellOnGameObjectBody now writes GAMEOBJECT 0x0800 alone; the client-internal LOCKED 0x4000 bit is consumed before wire construction. The canonical spell 1 / GUID 0x1234 body is byte-pinned and the OPEN_LOCK runtime path is source-pinned.
